scope: All system packages and the non-dpkg Python/pip runtime in the original public-only VC judge image.

debian.direct_snapshot_verification: HTTPS acquisition from the official Debian snapshot followed by Source, Version and dsc-declared SHA-256/size checks.

other_payload.vc_validate: Exact accompanying GPL-3.0 source and build instructions are declared separately.
other_payload.project_scripts: Project-authored Python and shell sources are already present as readable files; the project Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE accompany them.
other_payload.public_instances: The existing PACE CC BY 4.0 notice and complete license accompany the odd-numbered 100 public instances.

limitations: The signed dsc files are retained, but their OpenPGP signatures were not independently verified; apt authenticated the repository metadata during acquisition.
Mechanical source and notice coverage does not replace final release approval.
